title: Contractors
hint: Who hires the freight. The record is created from the first invoice; here you adjust each one's data and the cargo receiving rules.

table.name: Name
table.empty: No contractor yet. They show up here when the first invoice is imported.

ficha.readOnly: You can see the data, but only people who manage settings can change it.
ficha.profileError: Could not load the receiving profile: {{code}}

details.title: Contractor data
details.displayNameHint: How the contractor shows up on screen. The tax ID is its identity and is not edited here.
details.closingPeriodHint: How often this contractor's freight is closed into an invoice.
details.reportEmailHint: Where the closed batch report goes. Empty means the batch is exported by hand.

profile.title: Receiving profile
profile.intro: How this contractor's cargo arrives and is sorted before it becomes a trip. With no profile, or with the profile off, the flow stays as it is today.
profile.isEnabledHint: Off, this contractor follows today's flow: no receiving rule applies.
profile.requiresDamageCheckHint: Keeps the decision to check damage on arrival. The damage screen does not exist yet; for now this is only recorded.
profile.separationWindowHoursHint: Hours, counted from arrival, to sort the cargo and report damage. Empty means the arrival has no sorting clock.
profile.deliveryDeadlineBusinessDaysHint: Business days, counted from arrival, to deliver. The deadline panel will use it when available; for now it is only stored. Empty means no deadline.
profile.matchWindowDaysHint: How many days after the preview an XML can still be linked to it. The default is 15.
profile.weightTolerancePercentHint: Weight difference accepted when linking a preview line to an invoice, in percent. Zero requires the exact weight.
profile.previewEnabledHint: The contractor sends a preview spreadsheet before the cargo arrives. Reading the spreadsheet is still under construction; turning it on now keeps the column map for when it exists.
profile.previewSheetNameHint: Spreadsheet tab that holds the data, up to 31 characters. Empty means the first tab.
profile.columnMapHint: For each field, the exact column name in the contractor's spreadsheet. Leave blank what the spreadsheet does not carry. Route, value and weight are required to read the preview.
profile.arrivalReferenceLabelHint: In the invoice additional information, what is written right before the cargo number, such as NroCarga: (copy it exactly, with the colon). Empty means the cargo number is not read.

issues.tooManyDecimals: Use at most two decimal places.
issues.controlCharacter: Use a single line, without tabs or line breaks.
issues.duplicateColumn: This column is already in another field.

watchers.title: Owners of this contractor — replaces the company list
watchers.description: The fixed attendant for this contractor. With any active owner here, only they are copied on this contractor's e-mails; with none active, the company list applies.

occurrenceChannel.title: Occurrence notice — how it reaches the contractor
occurrenceChannel.description: Choose whether this contractor's automatic occurrence notice goes out by email or is posted to a WhatsApp group. Which types notify the contractor, and the text, stay defined on the occurrence type.
occurrenceChannel.loadError: Could not load the notice channel ({{code}}).
occurrenceChannel.emailHint: The notice goes out by email to the contractor's contacts, like the others.
occurrenceChannel.groupHint: The bot posts the notice in the chosen group, tagging the number given. No email goes out, except the fallback.
occurrenceChannel.hiddenTaken: {{count}} group(s) are hidden because they already belong to a driver or another contractor.
occurrenceChannel.phone: Number to tag in the group
occurrenceChannel.phoneHint: Phone with area code. The person must be in the group to be notified by the tag.
occurrenceChannel.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number with area code.
occurrenceChannel.emailFallback: Send by email if the group fails
occurrenceChannel.emailFallbackHint: If sending to the group fails after the retries, the notice goes out by email to the contractor's contacts.
occurrenceChannel.testSent: Test message sent to the group.
occurrenceChannel.saveBeforeTest: Save the changes to be able to send the test.

errors.CONTRACTOR_OCCURRENCE_GROUP_TAKEN: This group already belongs to a driver or another contractor. Choose another.
errors.CONTRACTOR_OCCURRENCE_GROUP_TEMPLATE_MIS: The WhatsApp template for the occurrence notice is missing in Notifications.
errors.CONTRACTOR_OCCURRENCE_GROUP_NOT_CONFIGUR: Save the channel as a WhatsApp group before testing.
errors.CONTRACTOR_OCCURRENCE_GROUP_TEST_FAILED: The test message did not reach the group. Check that WhatsApp is connected and the bot is in the group.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the group and the number entered.
